questions.question: Walk me through your role in preparing monthly and year-end closing statements at Blue Ridge Healthcare System, including the key reconciliations, journal entries, and controls you performed.
Describe your experience administering payroll and performing corporate payroll reconciliations and payroll tax activities. How did you verify completeness and accuracy before close?
This role requires accrual accounting and proper period-end cut-off. Can you give an example of how you identified, calculated, recorded, and later reversed or settled an accrual?
What types of journal entries have you prepared and posted, and what supporting documentation and review steps did you use to ensure they complied with GAAP?
You have used SAP to reconcile financial accounts. Which SAP functions or transactions did you use, and how did SAP support your account reconciliation and month-end processes?
Describe your experience managing AP and AR operations, including invoice processing, vendor payments, customer billing, collections, and resolution of discrepancies.
Tell me about a financial statement audit you supported. What schedules, reconciliations, or documentation did you prepare for auditors, and how did you resolve their questions?
How have you analyzed monthly department budgets, revenue, and expenditure trends to help managers maintain expenditure controls or make forecasting decisions?
Give an example of a business process, accounting policy, or internal control that you developed or improved. What issue did it address, and what was the outcome?

This position involves maintaining chart-of-accounts and cost-center reporting. Describe how you have charged expenses to accounts and cost centers, validated coding, and investigated reporting variances.
